text:
leo: Hey all  leo here, first day. Trying to finish obs setup: I cant see the Datadog dashboards for `private-inference`, Grafana alert buttons are greyed out on a team dashboard, and the Sentry DSN for our private cluster is missing. Who owns these three access bits?

ops-bot: Welcome @leo! Quick checklist: join `eng-observability` group, request Grafana folder access, open infra ticket for Sentry project. Docs/quick-start: https://redwood.internal/obs/setup :robot_face:

mira: @leo welcome! For Datadog you typically need `dashboards_read` and `monitors_write` scopes. If you paste the dashboard URL I can verify perms. Also we use `team:<team-name>` tags on dashboards so monitors auto-route into the right Slack channel.

jordan: Grafana alerting being greyed out usually means either folder-level edit perms are missing OR the private Grafana instance has alerts disabled for folders (we flip it per-customer). If you hover on the button does it show a tooltip? If it says "insufficient permissions" ping me and I can add you as Editor+Alerting. If it says "feature disabled" we need an infra toggle. For infra tickets use subject line like: `obs: enable-grafana-alerts team=leo cluster=private`.

leo: Dashboard URL: https://datadog.redwood.internal/dash/abcd-1234/private-inference?from_ts=1610000000000&to_ts=1610003600000

mira: Cool — I can see you're missing monitors_write. You can create a quick monitor via API while perms are being fixed, example (replace keys):
```\ncurl -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/monitor" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY" \n -H "DD-APPLICATION-KEY: $DD_APP_KEY" \n -d '{"name":"Private inference latency high","type":"metric alert","query":"avg(last_5m):avg:private.request.latency{env:prod} > 500","message":"@pagerduty latency > 500ms","tags":["team:leo"]}'\n```
Note: prefer creating monitors under a team-owned dashboard to ensure routing.

jordan: For Sentry on private, infra doesn't auto-provision projects. You need to request a project slug and mapping for environments. Infra will return a server DSN (for backend) and a public DSN (if allowed) and add the mapping to the private deploy config. Required info: org email domain, desired slug (e.g., `private-inference-leo`), service repo, envs (prod/staging).

leo: Filed infra ticket `OBS-1287` with slug `private-inference-leo`, org domain, and linked the Datadog dashboard + Grafana panel screenshot. Pinging @mira @jordan for perms changes.

mira: Thanks, pinged infra. In the meantime I can run the monitor creation for you if you want me to test alert routing. Want me to create a test monitor tagged `team:leo`?

leo: Yes please — also Im trying to embed a Grafana panel into Confluence for the runbook. Any recommended approach?

jordan: For Confluence we prefer either an iframe embed pointing to a signed Grafana panel link or a snapshot (if you don't want auth). If this is a private customer dashboard, we usually create a short-lived signed embed token. Send me the panel link and which Confluence page and Ill generate a token.

infra: Got OBS-1287. Ill provision the Sentry project and add leo to `eng-observability` after ownership confirmation. ETA ~ 2 business days. If you need faster access request `expedite` in the ticket.

ops-bot: Tip: use template `obs-onboard-v2` for infra tickets to pre-fill required fields: https://redwood.internal/infra/new?template=obs-onboard-v2

leo: Awesome, thanks everyone. Ill let you know when the ticket advances and will post the Grafana panel link for the Confluence embed. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
